mapper.select: select distinct d.dept_id as id, d.dept_name as name from sys_dept d where d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0' and ( exists (select 1 from emission_template t where t.dept_id = d.dept_id and t.template_type = 2) or exists (select 1 from emission_calculation_template ct join emission_template t on t.id = ct.template_id where ct.company_dept_id = d.dept_id and t.template_type = 2)) order by d.dept_id

select distinct year(ct.calculation_cycle_end_date) from emission_calculation_template ct join emission_template t on t.id = ct.template_id join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = ct.company_dept_id and d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0' where t.template_type = 2 and ct.calculation_cycle_end_date is not null order by 1 desc

select ct.id, ct.company_dept_id as companyId, dept.dept_name as companyName, ct.status, date_format(ct.calculation_cycle_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as start, date_format(ct.calculation_cycle_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as end, date_format(ct.calculation_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as completed, count(data.id) as dataCount, sum(case when data.id is not null and (data.data_status is null or data.data_status != 1) then 1 else 0 end) as problemCount, sum(case when data.id is not null and (data.carbon_emission_factor is null or nullif(trim(data.carbon_emission_factor_unit), '') is null or data.adjusted_carbon_emission is null) then 1 else 0 end) as factorMissingCount from emission_calculation_template ct join emission_template t on t.id = ct.template_id and t.template_type = 2 join sys_dept dept on dept.dept_id = ct.company_dept_id and dept.status = '0' and dept.del_flag = '0' left join emission_calculation_node cn on cn.calculation_template_id = ct.id left join emission_collection_node_data data on data.calculation_node_id = cn.id where ct.calculation_cycle_start_date <= #{end} and ct.calculation_cycle_end_date >= #{start} and ct.company_dept_id = #{companyId} group by ct.id, ct.company_dept_id, dept.dept_name, ct.status, ct.calculation_cycle_start_date, ct.calculation_cycle_end_date, ct.calculation_end_time order by ct.calculation_end_time desc, ct.id desc
